model: A character-level GPT (4 layers, d = 128, 4 heads, context 128, batch 32) on Tiny Shakespeare, AdamW.

healthy.label: healthy
healthy.note: Peak learning rate 3e-3 after 100 warmup steps, cosine decay, gradients clipped at norm 1.

bad_data.label: bad data, clipped
bad_data.note: Steps 700 to 709 train on random characters: a corrupted shard. Clipping limits each update.

bad_data_noclip.label: bad data, no clipping
bad_data_noclip.note: The same corrupted shard without gradient clipping.

lr_bug.label: learning-rate bug
lr_bug.note: For steps 700 to 759 a schedule bug multiplies the learning rate by 20.

high_lr.label: lr 1e-2, no warmup
high_lr.note: Peak learning rate 1e-2 from the first step, no warmup, no clipping.

high_lr_qknorm.label: lr 1e-2, no warmup, QK-layernorm
high_lr_qknorm.note: As before, with a layer norm on each head's queries and keys.
